review_method: Exact-source GitHub Actions job status and logs, downloaded artifact API SHA-256 verification, and manual receipt inspection. No local compiler, formatter, lint, automated checks or tests executed.

browser_native.publication_note: The private receipt validator required every space lifecycle fact. Generic publication sanitization redacts the boolean field named unmount_clears_secret_and_snapshot because its key contains secret; the public runner's passed result and exact source gate attest to that required private fact. No secret value is published.

limitations: This is an exact-source browser/native loopback development integration, not installed Windows, phone, physical LAN, public NAT, TUN, game, 24-hour, HA or full product acceptance.
Authority controls report server state; they do not install or replace the client's local authority trust pin.
Relay region and relative cost are advisory metadata; these UI receipts do not establish actual relay forwarding, grants, multi-hop policy, billing or relay-selection acceptance.
This focused receipt does not assert the results of the separate core, network rewrite or release workflows.
acceptance_claim: The production Web/native loopback job and its mandatory management, UI, synthetic media, owned input/files and physical cleanup gates passed at this exact source revision. Complete release qualification is not inferred.
